When notable changes are made to the system's design, it is important to update
the relevant design changelogs. This ensures that the documentation remains
current and accurately reflects the state of the codebase.

For example, when a design resolution is made, it should be documented in the
appropriate changelog file, such as
`docs/aria_timestrike/temporal_planner_design_resolutions.md`.

This practice helps to maintain a clear and accessible history of design
decisions, which is valuable for both current and future developers.
